entities.summary: Elena Quirici is a Swiss karateka. She won the gold medal in the women's kumite 68 kg event at the 2025 World Games held in Chengdu, China. She is a two-time medalist at the World Karate Championships and an eight-time medalist, including four golds, at the European Karate Championships.
